title: Format-Fallback Hero
prompt: Build the hero image of a product page as a : an AVIF source, a WebP source, and a JPEG fallback on the inner ; the carries intrinsic width="1600" height="800", meaningful alt (4+ characters), and fetchpriority="high".

tests.name: avif and webp sources
tests.hint: Sources are tried top-down: newest format first, oldest last.

tests.name: img fallback with dimensions
tests.hint: Intrinsic dimensions on the kill layout shift — they live on the img, never on a source.

tests.name: alt lives on the img
tests.hint: One image, one name: alt sits on the fallback and serves every source.

tests.name: hero priority is high
tests.hint: The largest visible image is the LCP candidate — pull it forward with fetchpriority.
